newsitem.title: USA: American Communications launches KC network.
newsitem.headline: American Communications launches KC network.

text.p: American Communications Services Inc said Tuesday it launched a multimillion dollar fiber optic network in downtown Kansas City.
The company said it plans to expand the network throughout the metropolitan area later this summer.
American Communications said it is investing nearly $20 million in the Kansas City fiber optic network, which will cover 70 route miles.
Compared with conventional copper-wire phone networks, fiber optics gives clearer transmission and increased capacity, needed for various voice and data services.
